SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D 9948 Date August 20, 1938. Station 7）
Date August 20, 1938.

Subject Strangers outside Lane 21, House No. 6, Chengtu Road, on August 19,
1938 - residence of D.I. Pan Lien-pih.

Made by D. I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by R W Mac Culie D.S.P.

I beg to report that three strange visitors were seen
outside my house, Lane 21, No. 6, Chengtu Road, at tiffin
time on Augu 19.

At 1.40 p.m. August 19, when I was upstairs in my room,
I saw from the verandah that one Chinese dressed in white
foreign style trousers and open shirt was talking to my ricsha
coolie who was standing outside the gate with the ricsha and
awaiting me. When I was about to enquire, the stranger
turned away from the gate and was hidden from my sight by the
wall. I then asked my coolie about the conversation, where-
upon the coolie replied that he was hawking for the sale of
tooth brush. I was turning away from the verandah when I
suddenly heard somebody saying "Lane 21, House No. 6."

I did not pay any attention to this remark at that time,
and left in my ricsha for office.

In the evening my coolie remarked to me that the visitors
in the daytime acted in a strange manner. On being questioned
he related as follows:-

" When I opened the gate at 1.40 p.m., 19.8.38, for the
purpose of pulling out the ricsha to the alleyway, I saw
three Chinese, all about 30 years of age, dressed in white
foreign style trousers and open shirts, standing in the
alleyway facing our house. Two of the group were each
holding a rattan box in his hand, while the third one
was empty-handed. When I had pulled the ricsha out and
placed it in front of our house just blocking the entrance,
I asked them why they stood there. One of the two men
with boxes answered by asking whether I wanted to buy any
tooth brush. When I answered in the negative, he

日期 1938年8月20日。

事由 1938年8月19日，成都路6号21弄潘廉彼督察官寓所外出现的陌生人。

呈报人 督察官 潘廉彼 转呈人 R W Mac Culie 副警务总监

谨此报告，8月19日午餐时间，有三名陌生访客出现在我位于成都路6号21弄的寓所外。

1938年8月19日下午1时40分，当我在楼上房间时，我从阳台看到一名身穿白色西式长裤和开襟衬衫的华人，正与站在门外拉着人力车等候我的车夫交谈。我正欲询问，那名陌生人便转身离开大门，被墙壁遮挡而脱离我的视线。随后我向车夫询问谈话内容，车夫回答说那人在兜售牙刷。我正要从阳台转身离开时，突然听到有人说“21弄6号”。

当时我并未留意这句话，随即乘坐人力车前往办公室。

傍晚时分，我的车夫对我说，白天的那些访客举止怪异。经追问，他陈述如下：

“1938年8月19日下午1时40分，我打开大门准备将人力车拉至弄堂时，看见三名华人都约莫三十岁，身穿白色西式长裤和开襟衬衫，站在弄堂里面对着我们家。其中两人手中各持一个藤箱，另一人则空手。当我把人力车拉出并停放在我家门前，正好挡住入口时，我问他们为何站在那里。那两个拿着箱子的人中有一人反问我要不要买牙刷。我回答不要，他便
